chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:

Indeed, when the servant performs the salat (prayer) in its time and safeguards it, it rises white and pure, saying: You preserved me; may Allah preserve you. And when he does not perform it in its time and does not safeguard it, it rises black and dark, saying: You neglected me; may Allah neglect you.

key_terms.الصَّلَاةَ: the ritual salat (prayer) whose timely performance is emphasized
key_terms.الْعَبْدَ: the servant of Allah, the human being addressed in moral responsibility
key_terms.بَيْضَاءَ نَقِيَّةً: white and pure, describing the luminous state of an accepted prayer
key_terms.حَافَظَ: he safeguarded and maintained it properly
key_terms.سَوْدَاءَ مُظْلِمَةً: black and dark, describing the state of a neglected prayer
key_terms.ضَيَّعْتَنِي: you neglected me, the prayer's reproach to the neglectful person
key_terms.وَقْتِهَا: its prescribed time, the appointed period for the prayer

ai.seo_question: What happens when a person performs salat (prayer) on time or neglects it?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the importance of performing salat (prayer) at its prescribed time and guarding it consistently. A timely and well-kept prayer rises in a luminous form and bears witness for the worshipper, while a neglected prayer rises in darkness and testifies against him.
